tbesh_html:
1) to supplant, circumvent, take by the heel, follow at the heel, assail insidiously, overreach
1a) (Qal) to supplant, overreach, attack at the heel
1b) (Piel) to hold back

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to seize by the heel; figuratively, to circumvent (as if tripping up the heels); also to restrain (as if holding by the heel)
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; properly, to swell out or up; used only as denominative from H6119 (עָקֵב),
strongs_1890.kjv_def: take by the heel, stay, supplant, [idiom] utterly.
